name: What are the key steps in a kitchen renovation process?

mainEntity.name: What are the key steps in a kitchen renovation process?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen renovation typically begins with design and planning, including material selection and layout finalization. This is followed by demolition of the existing kitchen. Next come rough-ins for plumbing and electrical, often accompanied by any necessary structural work. Once rough-ins pass inspection, insulation and drywall are installed. Cabinet installation follows, then flooring, countertops, and appliance installation. The final stage involves plumbing and electrical trim-out, backsplash installation, painting, and final touches. Each step requires coordination to ensure a smooth project flow.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key steps include design, demolition, rough-ins (plumbing/electrical), drywall, cabinet installation, flooring, countertops, appliance setup, and final trim work.
